triad.label: Triad
triad.fil: Pangkat na may tatlong tao. Nagpapalitan sila ng papel sa pagsasanay upang makasubok ang bawat isa.
triad.en: A group of three people who take turns in the practice roles.

observer.label: Observer
observer.fil: Tagamasid. Itinatala niya ang aktuwal na nakita o narinig sa pagsasanay.
observer.en: A person who watches the practice and records what they actually see or hear.

facilitator.label: Facilitator
facilitator.fil: Taong gumagabay sa talakayan o pagsasanay. Sundin ang nakasaad sa aralin kung sino ang susuri sa pagganap.
facilitator.en: The person guiding the discussion or practice. Follow the lesson’s instructions about who assesses performance.

feedback.label: Feedback
feedback.fil: Puna tungkol sa ginawa: ano ang malinaw o maayos, at ano ang kailangang ayusin. Ang puna ng kapareha ay hindi awtomatikong grado.
feedback.en: Comments about what was clear or done well and what needs improvement. Peer comments are not automatically a grade.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.fil: Paalala o gabay na ibinigay habang ginagawa ang isang hakbang. Ang “na-prompt” ay nangangahulugang may tumulong o nagpaalala.
prompt.en: A cue or reminder given during a step. “Prompted” means the person received help or a reminder.

rehearsal.label: Rehearsal
rehearsal.fil: Pagsasanay bago ang aktuwal na pagpapakita ng gawain. Hindi ito awtomatikong patunay na pumasa ka.
rehearsal.en: Practice before demonstrating the task. It is not automatic evidence of passing.

rubric.label: Rubric
rubric.fil: Gabay na nagsasabi kung anong mga kilos o ebidensya ang susuriin at kung paano bibigyan ng marka.
rubric.en: A guide describing the actions or evidence to assess and how they are scored.

role-play.label: Role-play
role-play.fil: Pagsasanay na may ginagampanang papel, gaya ng BHW o residente, sa isang kunwaring sitwasyon.
role-play.en: Practice in which people act as a BHW, resident or another role in a fictional situation.

dummy.label: Dummy materials
dummy.fil: Mga kunwaring gamit para sa pagsasanay. Gamitin lamang ang materyal na pinapayagan sa aralin.
dummy.en: Practice props rather than real working materials. Use only the materials permitted by the lesson.

handover.label: Handover
handover.fil: Pagpapasa ng mahalagang impormasyon sa kasama o kapalit: ano ang nagawa, ano ang kailangan pa, at sino ang susunod na kikilos.
handover.en: Passing essential information to a colleague or replacement: what was done, what remains and who acts next.

verification.label: Verification / verify
verification.fil: Pagtiyak ng impormasyon sa tala, tamang bersyon, o taong may awtoridad. Kapag hindi pa natiyak, sabihin kung ano ang hindi pa alam.
verification.en: Checking information against a record, the correct version or an authorized person. State what remains unknown.

safeguard.label: Safeguard
safeguard.fil: Pag-iingat o proteksyong kailangang manatili habang ginagawa o binabago ang isang gawain.
safeguard.en: A protection that must remain in place while doing or changing a task.

workload.label: Workload
workload.fil: Dami ng trabahong kailangang gawin o naibigay na serbisyo sa isang takdang panahon.
workload.en: The amount of work to do or services delivered during a given period.

audit.label: Resource audit
audit.fil: Maayos na pagsusuri at pagtatala ng gamit, bilang, at nakitang pag-aaksaya. Hindi ito pahintulot na bumili o baguhin ang serbisyo.
audit.en: An organized check of resources, counts and observed waste. It does not authorize purchases or service changes.

master.label: Controlled / approved master
master.fil: Kopyang ginagamit na batayan sa paggawa ng ibang kopya. Tiyakin sa awtorisadong tao ang kasalukuyang aprubadong bersyon; hindi sapat ang label lamang.
master.en: The reference copy used to make other copies. Confirm the current approved version with an authorized person; a label alone is not enough.

usable.label: Usable count / stock
usable.fil: Bilang ng gamit o kopyang maaari pang gamitin ayon sa kailangan at aprubadong bersyon. Hiwalay sa bilang na ito ang luma, sira, o hindi angkop na materyal.
usable.en: The count of materials or copies fit for the task and approved version. Old, damaged or unsuitable materials are counted separately.

baseline.label: Baseline
baseline.fil: Naitalang kalagayan o bilang bago simulan ang pagbabago. Ito ang panimulang batayan sa paghahambing.
baseline.en: The recorded situation or count before a change begins, used as the starting point for comparison.

denominator.label: Denominator
denominator.fil: Kabuuang bilang na pinagbabatayan ng isang bahagi o rate. Linawin kung pahina, session, o ibang yunit ang binibilang bago maghambing.
denominator.en: The total used as the basis of a fraction or rate. Identify whether it counts pages, sessions or another unit before comparing.

percentage-points.label: Percentage points
percentage-points.fil: Pagitan ng dalawang porsiyento. Iba ito sa porsiyento ng ibinaba kumpara sa dating bilang.
percentage-points.en: The difference between two percentages. This differs from the percentage decrease relative to the original count.

trial.label: Trial
trial.fil: Limitadong pagsubok ng isang mungkahing pagbabago. Kailangan pa rin ang nakasaad na pahintulot, pagsukat at pagsusuri bago magpasya kung itutuloy.
trial.en: A limited test of a proposed change. The stated permission, measurements and review are still required before deciding whether to continue.

rework.label: Rework
rework.fil: Pag-uulit ng trabaho dahil may kailangang itama sa naunang ginawa.
rework.en: Work repeated because something in the earlier work needs correction.
